projectDescription: A Python toolkit for static analysis of Fortran source code, implementing a 19-step pipeline that analyzes F77/F90/F95 corpora for structure, complexity, dead code, clone detection, and migration risk.
keyFeatures: 19-step static analysis pipeline for Fortran F77/F90/F95 source code
No external parser required — custom logical-line reader handles hybrid corpora
McCabe cyclomatic complexity per program unit
Dead code detection via BFS reachability from entry points
Clone detection: identical, similar, and diverged duplicate unit pairs
Composite migration risk scoring and unit prioritization
E4 ScopeManager: variable declarations, derived types, EQUIVALENCE aliasing
Call graph visualization via Graphviz DOT files
Self-contained HTML report with filterable/sortable unit table
Opt-in per-file parallelism via `--workers N` / `FORT_WORKERS` env var
Structured logging via loguru with per-run log file
publicApiSurface: forti4d.run_pipeline(source_dir, results_dir, *, from_step, only, skip, continue_on_error, workers, on_step_start, on_step_end)
